info.name: NEC - Training Attendance API
info.description:
Training Attendance API endpoints for NEC Middleware.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080/nec
Class-level path: /api/training/attendance

Response wrapper (all endpoints):
{
  "status": 200 | 201,
  "message": "...",
  "data": { ... }
}

NOTES:
- /createAttendance and /upload-signed-sheet use multipart/form-data.
- Max file size: 20MB, Max request size: 50MB.

formdata.description: Long (required) — ID of the training class
String (required) — JSON array. Each item: { universityTraineeId: Long, isPresent: Boolean }

request.description:
Creates a new training attendance record.

Uses multipart/form-data (NOT JSON body).

Form fields:
- trainingClassId: Long (required)
- attendanceDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- attendanceRecords: String (required) — JSON array, e.g.:
  [{"universityTraineeId": 1, "isPresent": true}]
- signedSheet: MultipartFile (optional) — max 20MB

Returns HTTP 201 on success.

Returns an attendance grid for a specific university and training class.

Response data shape:
{
  "classId": Long,
  "className": String,
  "universityId": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "scheduleDates": ["YYYY-MM-DD", ...],
  "trainees": [
    {
      "trainee": { "id": Long, "value": String },
      "attendanceRecords": [ ... ]
    }
  ]
}

Request body fields (both required):
- universityId: Long
- classId: Long

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Saves attendance records for multiple trainees in a training class.

Request body fields:
- classId: Long (required)
- universityId: Long (required)
- markedBy: String (optional)
- attendanceEntries: Array (required, non-empty)
  Each entry:
  - traineeId: Long (required)
  - attendanceRecords: Array (required, non-empty)
    Each record:
    - attendanceDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
    - status: String (required) — e.g. 'Present', 'Absent'

Response data shape:
{
  "success": Boolean,
  "message": String,
  "summary": { ... }
}

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of training attendance records sorted by createdAt DESC.

Query params:
- page: int (default 0)
- size: int (default 10)

Request body (all fields optional — send {} to get all records):
- trainingClassId: Long
- traineeId: Long
- fromDate: LocalDate (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
- toDate: LocalDate (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
- isPresent: Boolean
- isActive: Boolean

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Activates or deactivates a training attendance record by its numeric DB ID.

Path variable:
- id: Long — the attendance record's database ID

Query param:
- isActive: Boolean (required) — true to activate, false to deactivate

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

JSON part (required) — UploadSignedAttendanceRequestDto:
  trainingClassId: Long (required)
  universityId: Long (required)
  fromDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
  toDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
  uploadedBy: String (optional)
File (required) — The signed attendance sheet file (PDF/image, max 20MB).

request.description:
Uploads a signed attendance sheet for a training class.

Uses multipart/form-data with two parts:

1. 'request' (application/json part):
   - trainingClassId: Long (required)
   - universityId: Long (required)
   - fromDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
   - toDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
   - uploadedBy: String (optional)

2. 'signedSheet' (file part, required) — PDF or image, max 20MB

Response data shape:
{
  "id": Long,
  "trainingClassId": Long,
  "universityId": Long,
  "fromDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "toDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "filePath": String,
  "uploadedBy": String
}

Returns HTTP 201 on success.
